name: Spotting a Killer
source:
A silly, little fan game inspired by a friend's headcanon for Akudama Drive. 

Ordinary Person is excited for a night out to get takoyaki for once after work, but a sudden noise on the path catches her attention and natural curiosity...

[From [url=https://hoepunkausta.itch.io/spotting-a-killer]Itch.io[/url]]
